start_here: Say to your AI: "Give the latest answers to a form as plain lines, each starting with the question it answers, ready to hand to a writer or a summary, from the database", with {"form_id":"sample-intake","respondent_id":"respondent-1"}. It runs tool:read-latest-answers-as-lines and answers {"lines":["Budget: 2000"]}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it keeps its rows in tables of your own database, reached only on the local port your computer reports as own-rows-postgres.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Give the latest answers to a form as plain lines, each starting with the question it answers, ready to hand to a writer or a summary, from the database", and give it form_id (the form), and optionally respondent_id.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-latest-answers-as-lines and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: The form is read from the table question_sequence and its answers from answer_fact. Returns lines: the most recent time the form was answered, one "Question: answer" line per non-empty answer (the bare answer when the question's label is not known).
4. It keeps its rows in tables of your own database, reached only on the local port your computer reports as own-rows-postgres.
